scheme_name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Skill Up-gradation Centers (SUCs)
other_conditions: Industrial Parks, SEZs, GIDC Estates, Investment Regions and other registered estates are eligible to apply
The applying entity must provide the land or building for the Skill Up‑gradation Centre
The training partner must have at least 10 years of experience in skill training
The centre must train a minimum of 180 candidates per year
Placement of trainees must achieve 60% placement in the first two years and 75% in the last three years
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹1 crore for machinery/equipment, plus additional support for awareness programmes, other expenditures and transportation reimbursement for trainees.
